summary: The fix is correct and minimal. With fenced_code and attr_list but no codehilite, non-string Pygments options such as linenums are now left out of the output. Other attributes still render. The full suite passes.

own_checks.check: The issue's example no longer crashes and renders a plain code block
Other attributes are kept alongside bool options (data-x with linenums="true")
hl_lines, both inside attrs and in the legacy form outside them, does not crash without codehilite
Valueless non-bool attributes and a string value of "0" are still output, so existing behaviour is unchanged
own_checks.command: probes with data-n="0" title="a" and a bare data-n
own_checks.output_excerpt: data-n="0" title="a"; bare data-n renders data-n="data-n"

notes: The isinstance(v, str) filter also drops the list value of hl_lines without codehilite. Before the change this would have crashed, so dropping it is consistent with the fix.
The changelog entry has no issue number. The existing entries do.
The new tests cover the bare flag, explicit bool values, use_pygments="false" and a mix with another attribute. They do not cover hl_lines without codehilite.
